title: 第17章 阐教图穷匕首现阐截弟子斗灵宝第18章 清净琉璃对定海三光神水显神威
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
林镜没想到圣人也如此不要面皮，现在不仅要他交出九九散魄葫芦，而且还要赔偿一件先天灵宝！
他现在除了拥有一件超越极品先天的水火葫芦之外，哪里还有什么其他灵宝！
看着对面广成子和赤精子眼眸中闪过的一丝贪婪，看来他们不仅想抢走九九散魄葫芦，现在连水火葫芦也想收入囊中！
大殿之中，元始天尊的话音刚落，众人的目光都落在了林镜身上！
多宝道人伸手将林镜护在身后，眼眸死死的盯着对面几人！
通天教主转头看着元始天尊沉声说道：
“师兄，这事情到底是如何可不能只听信你弟子的一面之词！我相信我的弟子不会做出这等事情的！”
林镜看着直到现在还十分客气的师尊，心里微微叹息！
红花白藕青荷叶，三教原本是一家！恐怕只有师尊还一直把这句话当真了！
直到封神大劫末期，准提接引联合太清圣人和元始天尊一起破除诛仙剑阵，截教覆灭之时
，通天教主才明白三清早就不是当年的兄弟了！
元始天尊轻笑一声，看着一旁的通天教主，毫不客气的说道：
“我阐教弟子皆是根骨优秀秉性纯良之辈，可不是一些湿身卵化披毛带甲之辈能够比得了的！”
言语之间皆是鄙夷，这话连通天教主听完都有些愤怒！
什么意思，就你阐教弟子是好人，说什么就是什么吗？
这时，文殊广法天尊却是站起身向元始天尊和通天教主行了一礼后慢悠悠的说道：
“师尊，三师伯！今日之事说到底还是因为区区几件灵宝才引起的争议，可不能因为这点小事影响了两教情谊啊！”
林镜无语的看了文殊广法天尊一眼，呵！区区几件灵宝？
快闭嘴吧！文殊菩萨！
元始天尊倒是低头看着他询问道：

“哦？文殊你这话是什么意思，难不成为了你口中的两教情谊，你两位师兄的伤就这么算了吗？”
文殊广法天尊直接跪倒在地，缓缓开口道：
“弟子斗胆，想和截教的师兄们一起斗一斗宝！”
林镜默默的看着这师徒两演的双簧，太假了，看样子很快就要图穷匕首现了！
果然，元始天尊表现的十分疑惑的询问道：
“何为斗宝？”
文殊广法天尊站起身，看了一眼对面的几人，然后笑着说道：
“很简单，我方和截教弟子各出一人，分别只操作一件灵宝对战，不用法力！输了的一方就要将灵宝无偿赠与对方！不论最终结果如何，广成子和赤精子师兄的事情都就此揭过，师尊觉得如何？”
“好！既然此事是因为灵宝而起，就应该以灵宝结束，为师觉得甚好，不知三弟意下如何？”
元始天尊和徒弟若无旁人的演完了双簧之后，就转过身看着通天教主笑意盈盈！
林镜和多宝道人对视一眼，果然还是冲着灵宝来的！
通天教主面上表情阴晴不定，眼眸冷冷的扫过几位昆仑金仙！
他自然看得出来现在这个情况明显是阐教早就计划好的，所以完全不想答应！
虽然关于九九散魄葫芦的事情他现在根本算不出了，不过他肯定还是愿意相信多宝道人和林镜所说的话的！
然而当他把目光投向多宝道人和林镜之时，却是看到了一脸兴奋的神情，似乎是对这个斗宝比赛十分有信心！
本来他都在考虑直接义正言辞的拒绝元始天尊的询问了，不过看着林镜那胸有成竹的模样，似乎答应也不是不妥！
不过，既然阐教都欺负上门来了，那不狠狠宰一波岂不是亏了！
于是，通天教主故作沉思的想了想，笑着说道：
“不错，这个想法的确既可以免去争斗，也能化解因果！不过一对一太少了吧！这样吧，你们四个都上吧！我截教也只出四个弟子如何？”
林镜对面，那四个昆仑金仙听到了通天教主的回答明显愣了一下！

这剧本不对啊？通天教主怎么这么轻易就同意了，他不应该义正言辞的拒绝，然后由元始天尊步步紧逼，最终才答应的吗？
怎么现在不仅同意了，还把他们都拉上斗宝了？
content_en:
Lin Jing did not expect that the saint would be so shameless. Now he was not only required to hand over the Jiujiu Soul Gourd, but also to compensate for an innate spiritual treasure!
In addition to possessing a water and fire gourd that is beyond the highest level of innateness, what other spiritual treasures does he have now!
Looking at the greed flashing in the eyes of Guangchengzi and Akazaki opposite, it seems that they not only want to snatch away the Jiujiu Sanso Gourd, but now they also want to take the Water and Fire Gourd!
In the main hall, as soon as Yuanshi Tianzun finished speaking, everyone's eyes fell on Lin Jing!
Taoist Duobao stretched out his hand to protect Lin Jing behind his back, his eyes fixed on the people opposite him!
Leader Tongtian turned to look at Yuanshi Tianzun and said in a deep voice:
"Senior brother, you can't just listen to your disciple's words about how this happened! I believe that my disciple would not do such a thing!"
Lin Jing looked at the master who was still very polite until now and sighed slightly in his heart!
Red flowers, white lotus roots and green lotus leaves, the three religions were originally one family! I'm afraid Master is the only one who still takes this sentence seriously!
Until the end of the Great Tribulation of the Gods, Zhunti Jieyin joined forces with Saint Taiqing and Yuanshi Tianzun to break the Zhuxian Sword Formation, and when the Jiejiao was destroyed
, Master Tongtian realized that Sanqing was no longer the brother he was back then!
Yuanshi Tianzun chuckled, looked at the Tongtian Cult Leader on the side, and said unceremoniously:
"The disciples of my Chan sect are all people of excellent character and pure nature. They are not comparable to those who turn into wet eggs and wear fur and armor!"
His words were full of contempt, and even the leader of Tongtian Cult was a little angry after hearing these words!
What do you mean, you just say that your disciples are good people, and that’s what you say?
At this time, Manjusri Guangfa Tianzun stood up and bowed to Yuanshi Tianzun and Tongtian Cult Master and said slowly:
"Master, Third Master! In the final analysis, today's matter is still a controversy caused by a few spiritual treasures. Don't let this trivial matter affect the friendship between the two religions!"
Lin Jing glanced at Manjusri Guangfa Tianzun speechlessly, ha! Just a few spiritual treasures?
Shut up! Manjusri Bodhisattva!
Yuanshi Tianzun looked down at him and asked:
"Oh? Manjusri, what do you mean by this? Is it possible that this is the friendship between the two religions you mentioned, and the injuries of your two senior brothers are just forgotten?"
Manjusri Guangfa Tianzun knelt down directly on the ground and slowly said:
"Disciple is brave and wants to fight for treasures with the fellow disciples of Jie Jiao!"
Lin Jing silently looked at the double act performed by the master and the apprentice. It was too fake. It looked like it would soon be revealed!
Sure enough, Yuanshi Tianzun asked with great confusion:
"What is Dou Bao?"
Manjushri Guangfa Tianzun stood up, glanced at the people opposite, and then said with a smile:
"It's very simple. One person each from our side and the Jiejiao disciples will only use one spiritual treasure to fight without using mana! The losing side will give the spiritual treasure to the other party for free! No matter what the final result is, the matter between Guangchengzi and Brother Chi Jingjing has been revealed. What do you think, Master?"
"Okay! Since this matter started because of the Lingbao, it should end with the Lingbao. I think it's very good for me. I wonder what my third brother wants?"
After Yuanshi Tianzun and his disciple finished playing the double act without anyone else around, they turned around and looked at Master Tongtian with a smile!
Lin Jing and Taoist Duobao looked at each other, and sure enough they were still aiming for Lingbao!
The expression on Lord Tongtian's face was uncertain, and his eyes coldly glanced at the several Kunlun Golden Immortals!
Naturally, he could see that the current situation was obviously planned by Chanjiao, so he didn't want to agree to it at all!
Although he can't figure out anything about the Jiujiu Sanso Gourd now, he is definitely still willing to believe what Taoist Duobao and Lin Jing said!
However, when he turned his attention to Taoist Duobao and Lin Jingzhi, he saw excited expressions on their faces, as if they were very confident in this treasure fighting competition!
Originally, he was considering rejecting Yuanshi Tianzun's inquiry directly and righteously, but looking at Lin Jing's confident attitude,It seems that agreeing is not inappropriate!
However, since Chanjiao has come to bully him, wouldn't it be a loss if he didn't punish him severely?
Therefore, the leader of Tongtian Cult thought for a while, pretending to be thoughtful, and said with a smile:
"Yes, this idea can indeed avoid fighting and resolve cause and effect! But one-on-one is too little! Let's do it, all four of you! How about I only have four disciples?"
Opposite Lin Jing, the four Kunlun Golden Immortals were obviously stunned when they heard the answer from Master Tongtian!
Is this script wrong? Why did Tongtian Cult Leader agree so easily? Shouldn't he have justly refused, and then Yuanshi Tianzun pressed him step by step, and finally agreed?
Why not only did he agree to it now, but he also roped them all into a treasure fight?
